skills/work-planner/scripts/sync.py:451-460 belongs() reads a task branch's last hyphenated word as the long-lived branch it belongs to before reading the target, but delivery-branches.md:173-180 reserves that word only for a unit changing several long-lived branches; a single-branch unit's slug comes from its Description and may end in a branch name. Probe with LONG_LIVED=(main, workspace): belongs('i01/e00/w04-tidy-workspace', 'i01/e00/w03-x') returns ('workspace',) and belongs('i01/e00/w04-document-main', 'main') returns ('main',). For a unit whose Component is main:src/..., a pull request from i01/e00/w04-tidy-workspace into a stacked branch is reported 'it targets i01/e00/workspace', a single base, so sync-mode.md:92-95 retargets it there without consulting the Component and the task merges into the wrong epic base. epic.md:87 states the same precedence. AC54's 'its Target finding names the base to retarget to' is false in that case. Fix: name the branch from the last slug word only when the work item's Component or the epic's bases confirm it, or have sync-mode always check the Component before retargeting. Verified fixed at 8ce70c28 by W40 (#1585): belongs() (sync.py:452-465) takes the last slug word only when another pull request naming the epic comes from a branch of the same stem ending in another long-lived branch, else the target's branch, else every base; misrouted() collects those heads from every pull request naming the epic. The probe scenario now reports 'one of i01/e00/main or i01/e00/workspace'. epic.md:87 and the sync.py docstring state the same rule, and sync-mode.md:93-95 confirms every Target base against the work item's Component before retargeting. Three new BranchContract tests fail at 39a2841e and pass here; mutants dropping the sibling check, the other-word exclusion, the stem guard or the target fallback are each killed. The fix introduces no defect.
